The '''Northern Alliance''' was a military and political alliance formed in 1839 by [[Theorin Commonwealth]], [[Imperial Rhovland]], and the [[Federation of Vinterholm]]. Its original purpose was to protect northern and western monarchies and aligned states against [[Astoria]] and other perceived threats to the old regional order.

== Origins ==

The alliance grew out of earlier cooperation between Theorin and Vinterholm. Rhovland joined the system through the 1839 March Conference, creating a broader framework for technology sharing, arms cooperation, trade, and mutual security.

The old source gives the alliance's full early name as the ''Northern Alliance against Astoria and Southern State Aggression''. This draft keeps the shorter common name.

== Expansion Of Role ==

By the late nineteenth century, the alliance had become active beyond its original western core. It backed partners and commercial interests in eastern theaters, fought in the [[Svetian War]] of 1880-1884, and later joined temporary relief operations during the 1891 [[Siege of Murah]].

The Svetian War connected the alliance to eastern [[Khalari]] politics. Northern Alliance-backed forces fought the [[Volgastani-Hamed Empire]] and [[Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate]], with [[Battle of Kaplan Ridge|Kaplan Ridge]] becoming the source-attested decisive battle. The later Murah relief operation showed the alliance's ability to organize temporary multinational action outside its original western security zone.

The alliance's relationship with the [[Vesperan Empire]] was complicated. It could cooperate with Vespera against common rivals, but Vesperan expansion into Belcanto, Veszprem, and other regions eventually made Vespera a strategic threat.

== Bakorian War ==

During the [[Bakorian War]], the Northern Alliance supported the [[Bakorian Republic]] with supplies, training, advisors, intelligence, and diplomatic backing. It did not intervene openly against Astoria.

The alliance's restraint reflected limited resources, internal disagreement, and rising concern over the Vesperan Empire. Bakoria's defeat exposed the limits of alliance guarantees and pushed members toward modernization.

== Path To The Great War ==

The alliance's anti-Vesperan posture helped prepare the later [[United Alignment of Nations]] coalition during the [[Avant Great War]]. It should not be confused with rejected old-source labels for the Great War coalition.
